raw: Agent Name: WebSurfer, Step Number: 6, Reason for Mistake: It reported the Royal Court page text as “Prinsessan Sofia har fött en son” on Prince Nicolas’s birth announcement, conflating Sofia with Madeleine; this mis-extraction could have led to identifying the wrong mother if not corrected later.
